units.source_text: 已故髭黑太政大臣与玉鬘尚侍，生有三男二女。

en.t: The late Grand Minister Higekuro and Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, had three sons and two daughters.

units.source_text: 髭黑大臣悉心抚育，指望他们长大成人，超群出众。

en.t: Minister Higekuro raised them with great care, hoping they would grow to adulthood and become outstanding people.

units.source_text: 岁月推迁，正在等得心焦的时候，髭黑大臣奄然长逝了。

en.t: As the years passed and he was anxiously waiting for that day, Minister Higekuro suddenly passed away.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人茫然若失，如同做了一梦。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura was left dazed and bereft, as though it had all been a dream.

units.source_text: 本来急于欲使女儿入宫，此时也只得延搁。

en.t: She had originally been eager to send her daughter to court, but now she had no choice but to postpone it.

units.source_text: 人心大都趋炎附势，髭黑大臣生前威势显赫，死后内部财物、领地等虽然依旧富足，并不衰减，但邸内气象变更，门庭日渐冷落。

en.t: People mostly follow power and influence; although Minister Higekuro had been imposing in life, and after his death the household wealth and estates remained abundant and undiminished, the atmosphere in the mansion changed, and visitors gradually grew fewer.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍的近亲中颇有闻达于世者。

en.t: Among Tamakazura's close relatives, quite a few were well known in the world.

units.source_text: 但身份高贵的戚族，往往反而不甚亲近。

en.t: Yet relatives of high rank were often, on the contrary, not very close to her.

units.source_text: 加之已故的髭黑大臣本性缺乏情感，与人落落寡合，别人对他也就心有隔阂。

en.t: Moreover, the late Minister Higekuro was by nature lacking in warmth and kept aloof from others, so people also felt a distance from him.

units.source_text: 恐是因此之故，玉鬘夫人竟没有一个可与亲近往来的人。

en.t: Perhaps for this reason, Lady Tamakazura ended up with no one at all with whom she could keep close company.

units.source_text: 六条院源氏主君一向把玉鬘当作自己女儿看待，从未变心。

en.t: Lord Genji of Rokujo-in had always treated Tamakazura as his own daughter and had never changed in his feelings toward her.

units.source_text: 临终时分配遗产，特地在遗嘱中写明，把玉鬘列在秋好皇后之次。

en.t: When he divided his estate at the end of his life, he made a special note in his will placing Tamakazura immediately after Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣对玉鬘也反比对嫡亲姐妹亲近，每逢有事，必来探访。

en.t: The Minister of the Right Yugiri was also closer to Tamakazura than to his own sisters, and whenever anything happened, he always came to visit her.
